nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage Docker build for the backend: a builder stage on node:22-alpine that installs the pnpm workspace with a frozen lockfile, compiles shared+backend via tsc, and prunes to a production dependency tree with `pnpm deploy`; a production stage that ships the compiled dist, Casbin model/policy, Drizzle migration SQL, and BeVietnamPro fonts, exposing port 3090 with `node dist/index.js`.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BuildKit cache mounts for the pnpm store and tsc build cache, and `pnpm deploy --prod` to inject workspace dependencies into a self-contained runtime tree that excludes root-only QA tooling.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Build stage that activates pnpm 10.33.0 via corepack, installs backend dependencies from the lockfile with cache mounts, compiles shared and backend TypeScript, and produces the pruned production dependency tree at /prod/backend.

nodes.name: production
nodes.summary: Runtime stage that copies the pruned node_modules, compiled dist, Casbin model.conf/policy.csv, Drizzle migration SQL plus journal, and Vietnamese fonts; exposes 3090 and runs `node dist/index.js` under NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist-style dockerignore that keeps the repo-root build context for pnpm workspace links while sending only the files referenced by backend/Dockerfile (manifests, tsconfigs, shared/backend source, drizzle SQL) and excluding tests and spec files.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent contract for the repository: strict trunk-based git on main only (no branches, worktrees, or PRs), a closed-loop SDLC (Understand → Plan → Implement → QA → Fix → Re-QA) with mandatory QA gates (lint, typecheck, backend/frontend tests, build, E2E), qa/ evidence artifacts for every run, and rules for keeping the .ua/ knowledge base current. Includes local and staging demo accounts.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Compact context entrypoint for development agents: defines the authority order when sources disagree, the repository shape (shared/backend/frontend/e2e/docs/plans/qa/deploy), core invariants (Drizzle-only, round2dp financial precision, JWT+Casbin gating), the progressive context-loading protocol driven by `pnpm context`, and HANDOFF.md task-state rules.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Root orchestration for the whole stack: `make dev` brings up compose infra, runs drizzle migrations, and starts backend (tsx watch) + frontend (vite) together; database lifecycle targets include backup-gated migrate, a lock-serialized `generate` (guards against journal double-claiming), a `db-drift-check` clean-tree probe, and `db-recreate`; the `demo` pipeline deploys to vantai.tingting.vip via GHCR image push, rollback snapshot, flock-guarded server-side migrate, and public health checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Degrades migrations and backups to warnings during `dev` startup so a failed backup never blocks development, while `make migrate` itself fails closed.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml
nodes.summary: Local development infrastructure: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 Postgres on 5441 (vector extension for the FAQ embedding fast lane), Redis 7 on 6391, and Adminer on 8083, all with silversea-* container names so the stack runs alongside the nepocorp project without collisions.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: Development Postgres 16 with the pgvector extension preinstalled, persisted in the silversea-pgdata volume and healthchecked via pg_isready; required for the FAQ vector(1536) cosine index.

nodes.name: redis
nodes.summary: Development Redis 7 container on 6391 with a redis-cli ping healthcheck, used by the backend for caching and report-cache invalidation.

nodes.name: adminer
nodes.summary: Adminer DB UI exposed on 8083, gated on the db container reaching a healthy state.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Root build-context exclude list for image builds: drops node_modules, dist, uploads, tests, coverage, plans, docs, deploy, markdown, and .env files from the context; also applies to backend image builds, which run from the repo root via backend/Makefile.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root manifest of the pnpm monorepo (`tingting`, pnpm 10.33.0) wiring scripts to Makefile targets (dev/setup/build), the context resolver, seed-data tooling, and eslint; carries a pnpm overrides block pinning security-sensitive transitive versions (esbuild, uuid, undici, js-yaml, and others).

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: Declares the frontend/backend/shared workspace packages and the postinstall build allowlist (esbuild, protobufjs, puppeteer, sharp) controlling which dependencies may run install scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript compiler baseline for all workspace packages: ES2022 target, ESNext modules with bundler resolution, strict mode, isolatedModules, and source maps; extended by the backend and frontend tsconfigs.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Backend image pipeline: `push` builds and pushes ghcr.io/4rankng/transting-backend with buildx (linux/amd64, dual latest + git-source tags, registry inline cache, GHCR auth via gh CLI), `build-local` produces a fast native-platform image, and the link-drivers targets dry-run/apply linking orphan driver profiles to matching user accounts.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @tingting/backend, an ESM package: dev via tsx watch, production build via tsc + fix-esm-imports, drizzle-kit database tasks, seeding through src/seed.ts, and split unit/integration test runners; depends on Express 5, Drizzle ORM, Casbin, socket.io, web-push, pdfkit, sharp, OpenTelemetry, and the @tingting/shared workspace package.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Backend TypeScript config extending the shared base with outDir dist, rootDir src, and incremental build info; includes all of src so typecheck and dev servers also cover tests.

nodes.name: tsconfig.build.json
nodes.summary: Production compile config that extends the backend tsconfig but excludes src/tests and *.test.ts/*.spec.ts files, so the shipped dist contains runtime code only.

nodes.name: docker-compose.prod.yml
nodes.summary: Production compose stack for the vantai.tingting.vip deployment: pgvector Postgres 16, Redis 7 (128 MB allkeys-LRU with AOF), backend and frontend images from GHCR, and an optional Adminer profile; every host port is published to loopback only, behind the nginx reverse proxy.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image because the FAQ fast lane needs the vector(1536) cosine index; Redis is capped at 128 MB with allkeys-lru eviction plus append-only persistence.

nodes.name: seed-staging-2026-08-05-customer-sites.sql
nodes.summary: Idempotent staging seed inserting three customer-owned operational sites (Bien Bac + XNK HN) into operational_sites, closing defect DEF-20260804-002 where the factory dropdown rendered empty; unique on (customer_id, code) among live rows.

nodes.name: seed-staging-quytrinh-sites.sql
nodes.summary: Deferred staging seed of eight Long Minh factory/warehouse operational sites extracted from the NHÀ MÁY sheet of the customer delivery workbook; explicitly gated on migration 0170 (CREATE TABLE operational_sites) shipping in a newer backend image than staging ran at authoring time.

nodes.name: seed-staging-quytrinh.sql
nodes.summary: Additive, idempotent upsert of real customer master data into staging: Silver Sea company identity into app_settings, the Long Minh partner with linked supplier and customer (real tax ID 2300540419, chi ho 25 / cuoc 15 day payment terms), and a debit-note template — preserves existing demo trips and users.

nodes.name: seed-vantai-6months.sql
nodes.summary: Six-month realistic Vietnamese trucking demo dataset for the vantai staging server: truncates the operational tables and re-inserts users (password 123456), fleet, routes, pricing, road config, ports, trips with legs and expenses, penalty reasons, and ledger entries.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the whole rebuild in BEGIN/COMMIT with an explicit TRUNCATE list, so re-running resets the demo environment atomically.

nodes.name: seed-vantai.sql
nodes.summary: Base demo seed with the same shape as the 6-month variant: clean-slate truncate plus users, fleet, master data, pricing, trips with legs/expenses, and ledger rows for the vantai demo server.

nodes.name: drizzle.config.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle Kit configuration pointing schema generation at the split schema barrel src/db/schema/index.ts and emitting SQL migrations to backend/drizzle for the PostgreSQL dialect.

nodes.name: agentSocket.ts
nodes.summary: Real-time transport for the command-and-insight assistant: a socket.io /agent namespace on the shared HTTP server that streams AG-UI protocol AgentEvent frames (tool calls, directives, RUN_FINISHED/RUN_ERROR) and routes messages through the intent router, FAQ fast lane, and specialized LLM lanes behind JWT handshake auth.
nodes.languageNotes: Auth mirrors the REST middleware by carrying the JWT in the socket.io handshake (auth.token) so the bot impersonates the caller; conversation history stays on REST.

nodes.name: enforcer.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the singleton Casbin enforcer from model.conf plus policy.csv at process boot and exposes it to the authorization middleware; policy edits require a process restart because the CSV loads once.

nodes.name: model.conf
nodes.summary: Casbin ACL model definition: subject/object/action request tuples matched against policies with wildcard support on object and action, using a first-allow policy effect.

nodes.name: policy.csv
nodes.summary: Casbin policy matrix granting resource-level read/write/delete permissions across trips, config, financial, users, shipments, and audit resources to ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT, DISPATCHER, OPS, CUS, DRIVER, and CUSTOMER roles, with wildcard admin access and inline comments documenting route-scoped exceptions.
nodes.languageNotes: Comment lines inside the CSV document deliberate exceptions, e.g. dispatchers may create fleet resources only via a route-scoped POST allowance enforced in the casbin middleware.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Zod-validated environment configuration exposing the typed config object used across the backend: database and Redis URLs, JWT secret with production-length enforcement, token TTL, upload dir, VAPID push subject, trust-proxy parsing, and strict feature-flag parsing where only true/1/yes enables a flag.

nodes.name: backfill-faq-embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: One-off idempotent script that embeds faq_entries rows whose embedding is NULL using OpenRouter text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) and writes the vectors via raw SQL; run manually after the 0104 migration seeds FAQ rows.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Creates the postgres.js client from the configured database URL and the Drizzle instance bound to the full schema barrel; exports the canonical db client and Database type every service consumes.

nodes.name: master-data-name.ts
nodes.summary: SQL helper producing the operational display name for master-data rows — the configured short name when non-blank, coalescing onto the full name — so rolling deployments and legacy writers that only set name still render correctly.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-time transactional migration extracting unique trailer plate/type combinations from trucks.trailerPlateNumber into the standalone trailers table, skipping entirely when trailers already have rows.

nodes.name: _enums.ts
nodes.summary: Central catalog of 53 application-owned enum vocabularies — trip status, roles, shipment status and trade direction, POD states, fuel evidence review, salary confirmations, advance and credit-override states, master-import classification, and more — consumed by every schema module.
nodes.languageNotes: All enums are application-owned: PostgreSQL stores unrestricted text columns and TypeScript enforces the vocabulary, avoiding ALTER TYPE migrations when values change.

nodes.name: _shared.ts
nodes.summary: Shared schema primitives: the vector(1536) custom column type backing pgvector embeddings and the applicationEnum helper that layers TypeScript enum values over plain text columns.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Agent assistant tables: agent conversations and messages, FAQ entries with the vector(1536) embedding column for the RAG fast lane, and knowledge chunks.

nodes.name: core.ts
nodes.summary: Core platform tables: users, business calendar days, business units and their user links, audit logs, app settings, durable effect jobs, notifications, push subscriptions, photo geotags, scheduler run logs, idempotency keys, and delete requests.

nodes.name: costs.ts
nodes.summary: Cost-side tables: penalties, expense categories and expenses with photos, trip expenses and their photos, fuel invoices with allocations, fuel evidence reviews with OCR outcome, trip expense completion scopes, driver work days, progress events, and incidental costs.

nodes.name: financial.ts
nodes.summary: Largest schema module: ledger, trip financial postings, debit-note templates, billing documents with source period locks, trip claims, lines, recoverable claims and disputes, period locks, governance actions, financial reporting policy and truck profile versions, cap table history, distributions, management fees, salary periods with confirmations, closes and adjustments, advances with settlements and settlement requests, credit override requests, fuel recon explanations, and profitability snapshots with dimensions.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the 11 split schema modules (_shared, _enums, core, master-data, pricing, trips, costs, financial, treasury, shipments, agent) so drizzle-kit and `import * as schema` consumers see one unchanged surface after the schema.ts split.

nodes.name: master-data.ts
nodes.summary: Master-data tables: trucks, trailers, drivers with truck-driver assignments, partners, suppliers, tires and tire positions, customers with user-customer links, routes with polylines, cargo/container/seal types, dispatch zones, ports, forwarder expense types, operational sites, carrier fleet vehicles, and master-import batches with row results.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Pricing configuration tables: pricing tables, road allowances and road config, fuel config with price history, weight pricing tiers, lift pricing, ancillary revenue, fuel surcharge configs, fuel norms, and penalty reasons.

nodes.name: shipments.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment domain tables: shipments with documents, declarations, and status history, containers with charge and recovery facts, fulfillments, accounting locks, document custody facts, POD submissions and files, user-shipment links, salesperson assignments, change requests, milestones, customer-visible events with delivery attempts, delivery responses, acknowledgements and email logs, and dispatch handoffs.

nodes.name: treasury.ts
nodes.summary: Treasury tables: debt offsets, treasury accounts, payment receipts, treasury movements, payment allocations, and payment refunds.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Trip domain tables: trips, trip pairs, legs, containers and seals, instructions, trip code counters, photos, GPS tracks and GPS capture jobs, and vehicle last positions.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ApiError, the canonical typed HTTP error (statusCode, message, optional details) that services and routes throw instead of ad-hoc error shapes; rendered centrally by the global error handler.

nodes.name: locked-entity-manifest.ts
nodes.summary: Governance inventory binding each locked entity (terminal states, state authority, direct-mutation boundary, governed check/approve actions, reopen policy) to named TypeScript declarations and executable test blocks, so the exhaustive verification test can resolve every guard through the AST instead of trusting comments.
nodes.languageNotes: Bindings reference symbol + requiredFragments inside a specific declaration, preventing an unrelated assertion elsewhere in a file from satisfying the inventory.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Backend entry point: imports telemetry first, builds the Express app with CORS, initializes Casbin, DB, audit and notification services, mounts every route module (auth, config, trips, shipments, portal, agent, financial, expense, driver, forwarder, admin-gps, settings routers), attaches the agent socket.io server, starts the scheduler and durable-effect loops, and wires graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: renderResponseText
nodes.summary: Derives the terminal response text from an agent run result before it is emitted to the socket client.

nodes.name: initAgentSocket
nodes.summary: Creates the /agent socket.io namespace on the shared HTTP server, installs the auth handshake gate and message handlers, and reacts to app-settings changes for the runtime bot switch.

nodes.name: registerAuth
nodes.summary: Validates the JWT carried in the socket.io handshake, rejecting invalid, expired, or blacklisted tokens and non-office roles before any message handler runs.

nodes.name: registerHandlers
nodes.summary: Registers the per-socket message pipeline: rate limiting, intent routing, the FAQ fast lane, summary / financial-overview / deterministic-report / lookup lanes, streaming AG-UI events for tool activity, persisting conversation turns, and abort recording.

nodes.name: initEnforcer
nodes.summary: Builds the singleton Casbin enforcer from model.conf and policy.csv, logging the loaded policy count at boot.

nodes.name: getEnforcer
nodes.summary: Returns the initialized enforcer singleton, throwing a descriptive error when initEnforcer has not run yet.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Backfill entry point: verifies database reachability, selects FAQ rows with NULL embedding, embeds question plus variants in one batch, and writes each vector with raw SQL.

nodes.name: migrateTrailers
nodes.summary: Runs the one-time transactional migration that deduplicates truck trailer plates into the trailers table and links trucks to the new rows, skipping when trailers already exist.

nodes.name: applicationEnum
nodes.summary: Returns a text-column builder annotated with the given TypeScript enum values, letting schema modules enforce vocabularies without PostgreSQL enum types.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Canonical HTTP error carrying statusCode, message, and optional details; thrown by services and routes, and rendered with proper status by the global error handler.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Graceful-shutdown routine invoked on termination signals: stops the HTTP server, scheduler, and open DB/Redis connections before exit.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Shared formatting helpers consolidated from duplicated route and service code: Vietnamese currency formatting, local and Vietnamese date formats, HTML escaping for export views, SQL LIKE term escaping, and image MIME sniffing.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Pino structured logger that mixes trace_id and span_id from the active OpenTelemetry span into every record so logs correlate with traces; pino-pretty output in development, newline-delimited JSON in production.

nodes.name: redis.ts
nodes.summary: Redis client singleton plus the cache mechanics layer: single-flight cacheGet with a monotonic version guard that suppresses stale writes after invalidation, exact and pattern invalidation, and the JWT blacklist helpers used by auth and logout.
nodes.languageNotes: The version counter is globally monotonic on purpose — a cap-clear that resets the inflight map must never reset already-snapshotted versions or the stale-write guard becomes unsound.

nodes.name: report-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Single registry for reports:* cache keys: key builders, semantic mutation-to-cache groups, and invalidateReportCaches. Every site that spells a reports: key — invalidation lists, cacheGet setters, durable-effect enumeration — derives it from here, enforced by a source-scan unit test.

nodes.name: role-aliases.ts
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility layer for the CLERK-to-CUS and FORWARDER-to-OPS role migration: role canonicalization, legacy detection, modern-name lookup, and alias mapping exports; deprecated with removal planned after the migration window.

nodes.name: scoped-by-customer.ts
nodes.summary: Pure row-scope helpers for customer-portal access: force queries to the JWT's primary or linked customer set, overwrite caller-supplied customerIds to prevent cross-customer impersonation, and return a deny-all sentinel for misconfigured users.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry SDK bootstrap that must be the first import in the entry point so auto-instrumentation can patch express, pg, and ioredis as they load; exporter and sampling ratio are env-configurable with a console exporter fallback.

nodes.name: tx.ts
nodes.summary: runInTx optional-transaction runner that joins the caller's transaction when provided or opens a top-level one, plus the canonical Tx type re-export so routes can take the executor type without importing the db client.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: throwValidation converts a failed Zod parse into an ApiError 400 with a field-qualified message, keeping validation error shape consistent with the global error handler.

nodes.name: formatVND
nodes.summary: Formats a number as a Vietnamese-locale currency string with optional dong suffix, guarding non-finite input to zero.

nodes.name: formatLocalDate
nodes.summary: Returns the current date as YYYY-MM-DD in the server's local timezone, used for day-scoped queries and exports.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes the five HTML-special characters so user-supplied text renders safely in HTML statement exports.

nodes.name: formatDateVi
nodes.summary: Formats a date in Vietnamese display form for reports and exports.

nodes.name: formatDateShort
nodes.summary: Formats a date in the compact short form used in dense tables and list views.

nodes.name: sniffImageType
nodes.summary: Inspects uploaded file bytes (magic numbers) to determine the real image type, guarding against mislabeled or HEIC-encoded evidence photos before storage.

nodes.name: getRedis
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the shared ioredis client with conservative retry and connect-timeout settings plus error logging.

nodes.name: disconnectRedis
nodes.summary: Closes the Redis connection cleanly during graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: cacheGet
nodes.summary: Single-flight cache read-through: deduplicates concurrent misses per key, snapshots the monotonic version, fetches via the loader, and refuses to write back a value computed against a version that was invalidated mid-flight.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidate
nodes.summary: Invalidates specific cache keys and bumps their version so any in-flight cacheGet loader result is discarded instead of written back stale.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidatePattern
nodes.summary: Scans and deletes all keys matching a glob pattern (e.g. reports:pnl:*), bumping versions so pattern-wide invalidation also guards in-flight reads.

nodes.name: isTokenBlacklisted
nodes.summary: Checks whether a JWT's jti has been blacklisted by logout, consulted by the auth middleware and the agent socket handshake.

nodes.name: blacklistToken
nodes.summary: Adds a token ID to the logout blacklist with a TTL matching the token's remaining lifetime.

nodes.name: invalidateReportCaches
nodes.summary: Invalidates the report cache groups affected by an entity mutation, mapping semantic groups to their key patterns via the single registry.

nodes.name: getModernRole
nodes.summary: Maps any role (legacy or modern) to its modern CUS/OPS equivalent, returning the input unchanged for roles without an alias.

nodes.name: getRoleAliasMappings
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the legacy-to-modern role alias mapping for diagnostics and admin tooling.

nodes.name: customerScopeIds
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective customer-id scope for a user: the token's linked set for CUSTOMER roles, or the caller-supplied scope for operators.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomer
nodes.summary: Forces a single-customer query scope for CUSTOMER-role users, overwriting any caller-supplied customerId to the user's primary link so portal users cannot impersonate another customer.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Multi-customer variant for portal list endpoints: forces the scope to the user's full linked customer set with a deny-all sentinel when the user is misconfigured.

nodes.name: canAccessCustomer
nodes.summary: Predicate answering whether a user's effective customer scope permits accessing a specific customer id.

nodes.name: readSamplerRatio
nodes.summary: Parses the OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG env var into a TraceIdRatioBased sampling ratio, defaulting to 0.1.

nodes.name: startSdk
nodes.summary: Configures and starts the OpenTelemetry Node SDK with auto-instrumentations, the OTLP or console exporter, the ratio sampler, and service-name resource attributes.

nodes.name: runInTx
nodes.summary: Runs the callback inside the caller's transaction when one is provided, otherwise opens a top-level db.transaction — the single optional-transaction pattern used across command services.

nodes.name: throwValidation
nodes.summary: Throws an ApiError 400 from a ZodError, formatting the first issue's message with its field path and joining all issues into details.

nodes.name: asyncHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps async Express route handlers so rejected promises reach the global error handler via next(err) — required under Express 5, which otherwise hangs on unhandled rejections in route handlers.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Audit-log middleware for mutating requests: resolves the audit event, sanitizes request bodies, enriches the record with material-write context, persists the audit row with durable-effect finalization, and fails closed with a Vietnamese error when audit persistence breaks.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: JWT authentication middleware: verifies tokens against the Redis blacklist, loads the user's linked customer scope from the database, enforces customer-scope equality on scoped requests, and attaches req.user; also provides the asset variant for photo/file routes and the getUser helper.

nodes.name: casbin.ts
nodes.summary: Casbin authorization middleware mapping HTTP methods to read/write/delete actions against resource policies, with route-scoped role allowances (OPS posting shipment recovery facts, DISPATCHER creating fleet resources) and dedicated helpers for role requirements and trip routes.

nodes.name: errorHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Global error handler centralizing responses: ZodError to 400 with field-qualified Vietnamese messages, ApiError to its status code, Postgres unique violations to 409, and generic errors to a logged 500.

nodes.name: forwarder.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the forwarder profile for the authenticated user and attaches it to req.forwarder, eliminating repeated per-handler lookups across forwarder routes; augments the Express Request type globally.

nodes.name: material-write.ts
nodes.summary: Material-write registry and classifier: generates CRUD endpoint rules, matches incoming mutating requests against declared patterns, and exposes material-write context (entity, keys, idempotency endpoint) to the audit middleware and guards.

nodes.name: admin-gps.ts
nodes.summary: Admin GPS endpoints that seed and repair the real-route database after Google Directions was retired: a durable backfill command for the pending-trip backlog, per-trip recapture, and pending-snapshot selection, RBAC-gated to ADMIN and MANAGER at mount time.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: REST surface for the assistant's conversation history (list recent conversations, fetch one full history); live chat streams over the socket.io /agent namespace instead. Returns 503 on every route while the BOT_ENABLE setting is off.

nodes.name: asyncHandler
nodes.summary: Wraps an async route handler so rejections flow to next(err) and the global error handler under Express 5.

nodes.name: auditLogMiddleware
nodes.summary: Express middleware that intercepts mutating requests, resolves the registered audit event, sanitizes and enriches the audit metadata, persists the audit row with durable material-write finalization, and fails closed when the audit log cannot be written.

nodes.name: loadCurrentCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Loads the customer ids linked to a user, merging the primary customer with active user-customer links for role scoping.

nodes.name: sameCustomerScope
nodes.summary: Checks that a request's target customer scope matches the authenticated user's token scope, blocking cross-customer access for scoped roles.

nodes.name: authMiddleware
nodes.summary: Core JWT middleware: verifies the bearer token against the blacklist, loads the user and current customer scope, attaches req.user, and applies customer-scope equality checks for scoped roles.

nodes.name: assetAuthMiddleware
nodes.summary: Asset variant of the auth middleware for photo and file requests, authenticating via query token where headers are unavailable (img tags) while applying the same blacklist and scope checks.

nodes.name: getUser
nodes.summary: Returns the authenticated user from the request or throws a 401 ApiError for handlers that run after auth.

nodes.name: hasRouteScopedRoleAllowance
nodes.summary: Encodes the deliberate route-scoped exceptions to the Casbin policy: specific role + method + path-pattern combinations (shipment recovery-facts posts, dispatcher fleet creates) allowed beyond the base resource grants.

nodes.name: requireRoles
nodes.summary: Builds middleware restricting a route to an explicit allowlist of roles, independent of the resource-based Casbin check.

nodes.name: casbinAuthz
nodes.summary: Resource-level authorization factory: maps the HTTP method to an action, consults the enforcer with route-scoped allowances, and rejects with 403 when the role lacks the grant.

nodes.name: tripRouteAuthz
nodes.summary: Specialized Casbin guard for trip routes handling the trips resource authorization with its own allowance rules.

nodes.name: globalErrorHandler
nodes.summary: Terminal Express error handler translating ZodError, ApiError, Postgres unique violations, and unknown errors into consistent JSON responses with Vietnamese user-facing messages and server-side logging.

nodes.name: resolveForwarder
nodes.summary: Middleware that loads the forwarder profile for the authenticated user and attaches it to req.forwarder, 404ing when no profile exists.

nodes.name: createCrudMaterialWriteRules
nodes.summary: Derives the material-write rule set for a CRUD resource base path (create, update, delete patterns) used for audit classification and idempotency endpoint registration.

nodes.name: matchDeclaredMaterialWrite
nodes.summary: Matches a request method and path against the declared material-write rules, returning the classification the audit middleware attaches to audit records.

nodes.name: getMaterialWriteContext
nodes.summary: Extracts the material-write context (entity and key fields) from a matched request for audit enrichment.

nodes.name: captureAndDeriveTripGps
nodes.summary: Captures a trip's real GPS trail and derives track metadata, used by both the completion hook and the admin recapture endpoint.

nodes.name: selectBackfillTripIds
nodes.summary: Selects the ids of completed trips still missing GPS tracks within the requested window for backfill processing.

nodes.name: runDurableGpsCommand
nodes.summary: Executes a GPS backfill or recapture as a durable-effect job: enqueues the command, processes trips in batches with progress logging, handles retries and failure states, and reports the run summary.

nodes.name: createAdminGpsRouter
nodes.summary: Builds the admin GPS router exposing POST /backfill and POST /recapture/:tripId behind the gps-admin command key guard.

nodes.name: app-settings.ts
nodes.summary: App-settings router covering email settings GET/PUT, general settings updates split into direct changes versus financial-policy changes, and the governed financial reporting policy and truck-profile endpoints with their governance request flows — all behind idempotency keys and optimistic version checks.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication and user-administration router: login issuing JWTs with customer scope, logout with Redis token blacklisting, me/profile endpoints, password change, user CRUD, and business-unit CRUD — writes guarded by idempotency keys and optimistic-lock row versioning.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Config router aggregator from the T3c split: mounts the catalog CRUD, operational-config, tire-lifecycle, and salary-period routers, re-exports the audit-log router, and imports config-helpers for its governed singleton registrations — replacing the former 2,475-line config monolith.

nodes.name: audit-logs.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Paginated, sortable audit-log query endpoint moved out of the config monolith during the T3c split, delegating filtering to the audit-query service.

nodes.name: catalog-crud.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Generates and mounts 27 catalog CRUD routers (customers, trucks, trailers, drivers, suppliers, routes, pricing tables, penalty reasons, and more) via createCrudRouter with per-resource material-write rules, plus portal/clerk bootstrap endpoints and pricing aggregation reads.

nodes.name: emailSettingsResponse

nodes.name: syncSupplierRelationsHook

nodes.name: normalizeNoInvoiceApprovalTitle

nodes.name: tire-lifecycle.routes.ts

nodes.name: expense.ts

nodes.name: governance-actions.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Generic governance action surface: list pending and decided actions, fetch detail, and run check / approve / reject / return-for-evidence / cancel decisions, delegating to the adjustment-governance service.

nodes.name: ledger.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Ledger read endpoints: paginated ledger entries, per-customer balances, customer statements, and statement exports via the statement service.

nodes.name: payments.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Payment and treasury command center: receive payments, adjustments, vendor and carrier payments, commissions, driver payouts, supplier/carrier statements and payables summary, treasury position with account setup, cutover, and movement reversals, and the specialized governance check/approve commands for direct-money actions including profit distribution.

nodes.name: penalties.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Penalty endpoints: paginated list with filters, aggregated insights, idempotent create, and cancel — reads delegated to the penalty-reads service.

nodes.name: reports.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Financial reporting surface: dashboard stats and widgets, approval queue, P&L, profitability with export, receivables summary and aging with export, total AR, fuel variance, distribution history, profit-distribution preview and governed distribution, and payment-term evaluation.

nodes.name: snapshot.routes.ts

nodes.name: forwarder-admin.ts
nodes.summary: Admin views over forwarder operations: settlement ops-completion summaries by settlement ids and the forwarder trip-expense list.

nodes.name: containers.ts

nodes.name: expenses.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder expense CRUD and completion: create, patch, complete trip expenses, delete, and list unlinked expenses — a thin route layer since 2026-09-01, with write commands (lift-pricing resolution, advisory locks, audit keys) living in the command services.

nodes.name: receiveWorkbook
nodes.summary: Multer upload handler accepting the master-data workbook and handing it to the import pipeline's analyze stage.

nodes.name: requireReason

nodes.name: setDriverFuelEvidenceAfterUploadHookForTest
nodes.summary: Test seam allowing integration tests to override the post-upload fuel-evidence hook without touching production behavior.

nodes.name: releaseExpenseCleanupGuard
nodes.summary: Releases the expense cleanup guard after upload completion, logging failures for observability.

nodes.summary: Parses and validates the fuel-invoice id route parameter, throwing a Vietnamese 400 ApiError on invalid input.

nodes.name: parseActionId

nodes.summary: Loads the governance action kind for a pending direct-money action so the payments router can route it to the specialized transaction and application adapters.

nodes.name: runSnapshotRecaptureWriteCommand
nodes.summary: Runs a snapshot recapture through the idempotent write-command path, resolving the snapshot service by kind and reporting the recaptured row.

nodes.name: forwarder-shared.ts
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the forwarder route leaves: material-write audit context wrapper, mandatory idempotency-key guard, optimistic-concurrency (If-Unmodified-Since) helpers, and the forwarder zod schemas (container, paper-order collection, order exchange). Re-exports the domain command surface from forwarder-expense-commands.service so route leaves keep a single import site.
nodes.languageNotes: Pattern of re-exporting a service leaf's command surface (`export { ... } from '...'`) while keeping route-local helpers private to the mount.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder portal mount point: builds one router, applies the resolveForwarder middleware so every leaf sees the authenticated forwarder profile, then mounts the family leaves (trips, order-exchange, containers, expenses, advances, photos, types) split from the old single-file routes/forwarder.ts.

nodes.name: order-exchange.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder order-exchange commands: POST start/complete mark the shipment's order-exchange lifecycle timestamps, and POST paper-order-collection records handover of the original paper order. All three run inside withMaterialWriteAuditContext + runIdempotent with forwarder scope and accounting-unlock assertions, optimistic version checks, and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locks.

nodes.name: photos.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder expense-photo endpoints: listing with ownership gating (404 rather than 403 to prevent enumeration), upload with HEIC-safe sharp re-encode (EXIF strip, 2048px downscale) guarded by a durable storage cleanup lease, and an idempotent locked delete that requires If-Unmodified-Since.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-phase durability: storage upload happens before the DB transaction, with a cleanup-guard lease that is cancelled inside the transaction or released on rollback.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder trip reads: GET /trips list with optional search (container number or customer name) and departure-date filters plus status counts, and GET /trips/:id detail — both scoped to the resolved forwarder via forwarder.service queries.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder expense-type catalog: GET /expense-types returns each expense type row decorated with a no-invoice policy snapshot (substitute-evidence rules, per-item/per-day limits, approval titles) built by buildNoInvoicePolicySnapshot.

nodes.name: geotag.ts
nodes.summary: Geotag endpoints for phone GPS fixes attached to photo submissions: POST / validates against the shared geotagSchema and upserts idempotently through submitGeotag (ownership resolved per entity type, freshness gate on gpsAt), GET reads back with the same ownership gate.

nodes.name: gps-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Admin settings for the Bạch Khoa GPS tracking account: GET returns username plus masked-password indicator (plaintext never leaves the service), PUT upserts AES-encrypted app_settings rows under an idempotency key with optional If-Unmodified-Since version enforcement, then invalidates GPS settings/session/provider caches.

nodes.name: llm-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Admin LLM provider settings: choose the chatbot agent's provider (MiniMax or OpenRouter) and store its API key. Keys are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and only ever returned masked; PUT validates that the chosen provider has a key (allowing key+provider in one save) and invalidates settings/provider caches so the next agent turn picks up the change.

nodes.name: maps.ts
nodes.summary: Thin map-service proxies: GET /autocomplete for OpenStreetMap/Nominatim place suggestions (with a temporary ?debug=1 diagnostic mode) and GET /distance for route/distance lookups over real GPS-captured polylines.

nodes.name: notifications.ts
nodes.summary: Notification endpoints: unread count, paginated list, mark-one/mark-all read, plus web-push subscribe/unsubscribe and VAPID public key distribution so every role (DRIVER/FORWARDER/office) can opt in to push.

nodes.name: ocr-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Admin OCR settings: GET returns the enabled flag plus masked OpenRouter key indicator; PUT serializes mutations on a Postgres advisory lock, enforces optional version checks, refuses enabling OCR without an available key, and deletes any stale Gemini key row left from the removed provider.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(...))` to serialize concurrent settings mutations beyond the per-key idempotency lock.

nodes.name: ocr.ts
nodes.summary: OCR HTTP surface: POST / recognizes container/seal numbers from photos (persisting first when trip_id links a trip), POST /pump reads fuel-pump displays into a litres×price≈total suggestion with mismatch warning, POST /persist-only is the flush path that deliberately cannot re-run recognition, and /fuel-evidence-reviews exposes the accountant's confirm/reject queue. All routes rate-limit to 2 req/s and run through durable storage cleanup guards + idempotency.
nodes.languageNotes: The persist-only route encodes intent structurally (no reference to extractContainerAndSeal) instead of trusting a boolean flag, making a silent recognition-suppression impossible.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Customer portal API: customer-scope resolution, paginated shipment list/detail with customer-safe projections, e-POD file download, customer-visible event feed with acknowledge/delivery-response, debit-note list/confirm/dispute/export (PDF or templated XLSX), and account statement data/export.

nodes.name: recoverable-costs.ts
nodes.summary: Recoverable-cost endpoints for office roles: filtered list and detail reads, plus POST /:id/request which raises an idempotent APPROVED/REJECTED governance decision request (202) through requestRecoverableCostDecision.

nodes.name: salary.ts
nodes.summary: Driver salary HTTP surface: monthly salary list/detail enriched with post-close adjustments, work-day calendar read/batch upsert (guarded by confirmation status, closed-period locks, and pending governance actions), and the full governance ladder for period close/reopen/issue/post/adjustment and per-driver confirm/unconfirm — each with request, check, and approve stages routed idempotently through the governance-action services.
nodes.languageNotes: registerSalaryPeriodFinalizationDecisionRoutes is a route-registration factory that stamps out the check/approve pair for both ISSUE_PAYSLIPS and POST_OFFICIAL operations from one template.

nodes.name: coordination.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment coordination leaf: the customer-visible event feed (list/create), the clerk→dispatcher handoff lifecycle (latest read, create, and idempotent SEEN/ACCEPTED/REJECTED resolve where ACCEPTED delegates to acceptDispatchHandoff), and the ADMIN/MANAGER review of shipment change requests.

nodes.name: core.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment core leaf: paginated list + create (+ /quick idempotent mobile create), /:id read/update/soft-delete, status transitions, dispatch order issue, direct completion with VAT and no-photo overrides, fulfillment cancellation disposition, submit-for-dispatch, carrier allocations, recovery facts, and intake support endpoints (operational sites, pricing preview).

nodes.name: cus-workspace.routes.ts
nodes.summary: CUS clerk workspace leaf: overview/detail/container reads with strict per-endpoint query schemas, per-container line updates, finance confirmations, charge-proposal billing review, document custody updates, accounting lock activation, and the reopen-request/decision flow — all writes ride the idempotent runShipmentWrite envelope.

nodes.name: dispatch-planning.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Dispatch planning leaf: master-plan/detail-plan reads (handoff queue, dispatch queue, fleet by resource, port/zone facets, truck presence) and the single-save detail-plan editor commands — carrier assignment, plate assignment, estimate updates, detail-plan-row PATCHes — plus the external carrier-fleet vehicle catalog CRUD.

nodes.name: documents.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment attachment leaf: POST /:id/documents records an uploaded document's storageKey metadata (bytes go via /api/upload), /replace swaps a document version with optimistic locking, /declarations create/update tờ khai records, and GET/PUT /containers handle the container read/reconcile pair.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shipments router mount: registers ~25 audit events (suffix-mode, longest-suffix-wins) mapping every write path to SHIPMENT_*/ENTITY_* audit kinds, then mounts the six resource leaves (cus-workspace, dispatch-planning, core, documents, pod, coordination) in an order that keeps static segments ahead of the core leaf's /:id pattern.
nodes.languageNotes: Audit registration uses prefix+suffix matching with a longest-suffix-wins rule so `/containers` upserts are distinguishable from root updates on the same method.

nodes.name: pod.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment e-POD leaf: GET /:id/pod-files/:fileId streams a stored POD attachment with proper content-disposition, and POST /:id/pod-reviews/:submissionId/review is the CUS clerk's idempotent ACCEPT/REJECT decision on a driver's e-POD submission (podRecovered required on ACCEPT to confirm paper POD custody).

nodes.name: shipment-shared.ts
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the shipment leaf routers: the SHIPMENT_INTAKE_MUTATION_ROLES authority list, the idempotent runShipmentWrite envelope that threads actor + entity ids into audit locals, sendShipmentWrite response helper, and centralized parseId / requireShipmentIdempotencyKey guards.

nodes.name: containers.ts
nodes.summary: Trip containers and instructions leaf: PUT /:id/containers batch-upserts trip containers idempotently and invalidates report caches, GET/PUT /:id/instructions read and upsert manager-authored contact + free-text guidance for a trip.

nodes.name: withMaterialWriteAuditContext

nodes.name: setForwarderExpensePhotoAfterUploadHookForTest

nodes.name: requireIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the Idempotency-Key from header or body _requestId and throws 400 when neither is present, gating LLM settings mutations.

nodes.name: requireIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the Idempotency-Key from header or body _requestId and throws 400 when absent, gating OCR settings mutations.

nodes.name: toResponseBody
nodes.summary: Projects OCR settings into the response body: enabled flag, openrouterKeySet/KeyMasked, and updatedAt, keeping the API key masked.

nodes.name: withMaterialWriteAuditContext

nodes.name: setExtractPumpReadingHandlerForTest

nodes.name: toCustomerDebitNote

nodes.name: toCustomerShipmentDetail
