nodes.summary: Trip figure leaf: PUT /:id/pre-departure and /:id/actuals update planned vs post-trip figures; edits to a COMPLETED trip are diverted into a requestTripFinancialChange governance action instead of a direct write, and successful writes invalidate report caches.

nodes.name: fuel.ts
nodes.summary: Fuel voucher downloads for ADMIN/MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT: GET /:id/fuel-voucher/html renders the voucher as HTML and /xlsx streams the Excel export from fuel-voucher.service.

nodes.name: governance.ts
nodes.summary: Trip governance leaf: exceptional reopen (unlock) requests that keep a trip COMPLETED until separate checker/approver complete the governance action, plus departure-date changes that invalidate report caches on commit.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Trips router mount: registers TRIP_* audit events for every write path (create, copy, pre-departure, actuals, dispatch, complete, cancel, adjustment, unlock, departure-date) then mounts the nine family leaves in the old single-file registration order so static paths beat /:id patterns.

nodes.name: pod.ts
nodes.summary: Trip POD leaf: POST /:id/pod-recovered lets ACCOUNTANT/CUS mark paper-POD recovery with optimistic version; the legacy paper-order-collected and driver-order-accepted endpoints now return 410 pointing OPS/drivers at the FORWARDER/DRIVER portals' canonical flows.

nodes.name: reassignment.ts
nodes.summary: Dispatch reassignment leaf: PATCH /:id/reassign lets dispatchers correct truck/driver on issued orders pre-departure, routing governed fulfillments through reassignIssuedDispatchWriteCommand with fulfillment+trip version checks, and falling back to plain reassignTrip when the fulfillment no longer resolves.

nodes.name: status.ts
nodes.summary: Trip status lifecycle leaf: dispatch (via dispatchTripWriteCommand), complete (IN_TRANSIT→COMPLETED rides a requestTripFinancialClose governance action returning 202), and cancel — including completed-trip cancellation requests raised through adjustment governance.

nodes.name: trips-shared.ts
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the trips route leaves: expectedVersion body parsing, mandatory governance-reason extraction, the trip expense decision request schema, and the sort-key whitelist schema for the trips list.

nodes.name: upload.ts
nodes.summary: Upload + trip-photos HTTP surface: the upload router handles generic files and company logos (sharp preprocessed, storage-service persisted), while the photos router lists/creates/deletes trip photos with DRIVER ownership authz, durable cleanup guards, accounting-unlock assertions, and final-delete enqueueing — plus the exported prepareTripPhoto/insertTripPhotoRecord pipeline reused by the OCR routes.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-phase upload: storage write happens before the DB transaction with an armed cleanup-guard lease cancelled atomically inside the transaction or released on rollback.

nodes.name: crud-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Generic CRUD route factory for Drizzle tables: generates list/create/read/update/delete endpoints with pagination, search, sortable columns, soft/hard delete, unique-constraint→409 mapping, optimistic version locking, idempotent writes, and optional price-config governance hooks (before/after callbacks plus shouldGovern* predicates).
nodes.languageNotes: Narrows Drizzle's broad table type through a single `column()` boundary so dynamic soft-delete/search lookups don't leak `any` across the factory.

nodes.name: idempotency.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level helper that resolves a request's idempotency key from the Idempotency-Key header or the body's _requestId, delegating to the idempotency service's resolveIdempotencyKey.

nodes.name: getExpectedVersion
nodes.summary: Extracts an optional positive-integer expectedVersion from a request body, throwing 400 on an invalid value and returning undefined when absent.

nodes.name: getRequiredGovernanceReason
nodes.summary: Reads governanceReason (or reason) from the body and throws 400 when it is missing or blank — governance actions always require a stated justification.

nodes.name: withMaterialWriteAuditContext
nodes.summary: Wraps an upload-path write in runWithAuditRequestContext declaring the endpoint as a material write so the audit middleware records it.

nodes.name: setTripPhotoAfterUploadHookForTest
nodes.summary: Test seam that installs or clears the after-upload hook fired inside the trip-photo create transaction.

nodes.name: prepareTripPhoto
nodes.summary: Sniffs the image type, sharp-preprocesses (EXIF auto-rotate, 2048px downscale, q85 JPEG — or the OCR q95 auto-contrast pipeline when forOcr), and derives a deterministic storage key from the seed + hash so retries converge on one object.

nodes.name: findTripPhotoByStorageKey
nodes.summary: Looks up an existing trip_photos row by storage key so retrying a prepared upload converges on the original row instead of duplicating it.

nodes.name: insertTripPhotoRecord
nodes.summary: Inserts a trip_photos row (optionally container-linked) inside a transaction that first asserts shipment accounting is unlocked, reusing an existing row found by storage key for idempotent convergence.

nodes.name: enqueueTripPhotoFinalDelete
nodes.summary: Enqueues a durable final-delete job for a trip photo row and its storage object inside the caller's transaction, keyed by a deterministic dedupe key.

nodes.name: acquireUploadCleanupGuard
nodes.summary: Arms a storage cleanup guard lease for an upload: returns null when an idempotency record already exists, and turns an already-leased dedupe key into a wait-for-commit or a 409 conflict.

nodes.name: releaseUploadCleanupGuard
nodes.summary: Releases a storage cleanup lease on failure, logging (but not throwing) release errors so the original error propagates.

nodes.name: deleteTripPhotosByType
nodes.summary: Deletes all trip photos of a given type (optionally container-scoped): marks rows deleted and enqueues durable storage deletes for each key.

nodes.name: deleteTripPhotoByStorageKey
nodes.summary: Deletes a single trip photo identified by storage key, distinguishing protected keys that must keep storage objects from ordinary ones, and enqueues the durable final delete.

nodes.name: prepareCompanyLogo
nodes.summary: Preprocesses an uploaded company logo with sharp and derives its storage key from the supplied seed, for the company-info branding upload path.

nodes.name: isCompanyLogoStorageKey
nodes.summary: Returns whether a storage key belongs to the company-logo namespace, protecting logos from generic photo deletion paths.

nodes.name: isProtectedPhotoStorageKey
nodes.summary: Predicate for storage keys whose objects must not be garbage-collected by the durable delete sweeper (company logos and other protected namespaces).

nodes.name: apiErrorFromUniqueConstraint
nodes.summary: Translates a Postgres 23505 unique-violation (including Drizzle's err.cause wrapping) into a 409 ApiError naming the conflicting field from the error detail.

nodes.name: createCrudRouter
nodes.summary: Builds the standard REST router for a Drizzle table: list with pagination/search/sort, idempotent create/update/delete with optimistic version locking and row locks, soft-delete awareness, lifecycle callbacks, Redis invalidation, and optional governed CRUD that swaps direct writes for governance actions per the shouldGovern* predicates.

nodes.name: getRequestIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the request idempotency key from the Idempotency-Key header or body _requestId via the idempotency service — the single entry point every route uses.

nodes.name: pagination.ts
nodes.summary: Shared pagination parser that clamps page/limit consistently (defaults 1/50, max 100 overridable) and computes the offset — replacing the scattered inconsistent parseInt patterns across route files.

nodes.name: work-inbox.ts
nodes.summary: Work-inbox routers for each persona: forwarder, driver, customer-portal, financial, and system-admin health inboxes plus the manager decision-inbox with delivery-dispute resolution — all validated through one shared query parser and customer-scoping helper.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Scheduler barrel: re-exports the job registry and the cron runner so callers and tests import both from a single './scheduler' path.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Pure in-memory scheduler job registry: register/get/list/clear job definitions (name, 5-field cron, handler, retry policy) plus the FNV-1a-derived advisory-lock key that lets multiple backend pods race for the same Postgres lock with only one winner.
nodes.languageNotes: advisoryLockKey implements FNV-1a 32-bit in JS with Math.imul to stay 32-bit, then forces a positive int4 for pg_try_advisory_lock.

nodes.name: runner.ts
nodes.summary: Cron runner: boots registered non-disabled jobs onto node-cron (validating 5-field expressions), and per tick reserves a pooled connection, takes a session-scoped advisory lock, writes a scheduler_run_logs row through RUNNING→SUCCESS/FAILED with per-attempt updates, runs the handler with retries, and releases lock + connection in finally. stopScheduler drains in-flight ticks before shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Session-scoped advisory locks require pinning one pooled connection via reserve() so lock and unlock hit the same Postgres backend.

nodes.name: seed-dashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone dashboard seeder (npx tsx src/seed-dashboard.ts): idempotently seeds road config, the default 25→24 salary period, monthly management fees, then months of trips, receivables ledger entries, and expenses so dashboards show meaningful KPIs and alerts.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Primary database seeder: creates the demo user accounts (one per role incl. four extra drivers), links drivers by phone, then orchestrates the seed/* leaf modules (customers, reference data, pricing, sites, factories, ports, vehicles, trips, vendor financials, forwarder money, customer AR, bulk data) plus clerk scoping and shipment seeding — idempotent via normalized-text matching.

nodes.name: customers.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated customer master data (real 2026-07-30 delivery from the BIẾU MẪU BÁO CÁO extractor): the CustomerSeed array with tax codes, payment terms, and managers, plus the companyIdentity const describing Silver Sea's legal entity and bank details.

nodes.name: drivers.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated driver master data: DriverSeed rows with real names, tax codes, hometowns, and phone numbers extracted from the customer's report spreadsheets.

nodes.name: factories.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated factory/warehouse master data from the DATA PM workbook: FactorySeed rows carrying internal codes, addresses, invoice tax details, loading-dock instructions, and Google Maps links.

nodes.name: fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated truck fleet master data: TruckSeed rows pairing plates and trailer plates with vehicle class, primary driver name, max payload, and preferred route.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Seed-data barrel re-exporting every master-data array (customers, drivers, fleet, reference, pricing, samples, factories, vehicles) plus the ports-from-excel export under its aliased name.

nodes.name: parsePagination
nodes.summary: Parses and clamps page/limit query params with defaults and a max limit, returning page, limit, and the computed offset.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: Builds the InboxQuery from request params: validated page/limit, whitelist-checked sortBy/sortDir, plus optional view and search filters.

nodes.name: registerJob
nodes.summary: Registers a scheduler job, validating the name format and replacing any prior definition with the same name (idempotent for tests and tsx watch restarts).

nodes.name: getJob
nodes.summary: Fetches a registered job definition by name, returning undefined when absent.

nodes.name: listJobs
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot array of all registered scheduler jobs.

nodes.name: clearRegistry
nodes.summary: Clears the job registry — test-only helper for isolating state between suites.

nodes.name: advisoryLockKey
nodes.summary: Derives a stable positive int32 advisory-lock key from a job name using FNV-1a, so all pods running the same job race for the same Postgres lock.

nodes.name: startScheduler
nodes.summary: Boots every registered non-disabled job onto node-cron after validating the cron expression is 5-field and parseable; idempotent (a second call warns and no-ops) and tracks in-flight ticks for shutdown draining.

nodes.name: stopScheduler
nodes.summary: Stops all cron tasks and awaits in-flight ticks up to a drain timeout so dbClient.end() cannot terminate a handler mid-statement.

nodes.name: runJobTick
nodes.summary: Executes one job tick end-to-end: reserves a pooled connection, takes the session advisory lock (bailing silently when another pod holds it), writes the scheduler_run_logs row through RUNNING→SUCCESS/FAILED with per-attempt updates, and always releases lock and connection in finally.

nodes.name: executeWithRetries
nodes.summary: Runs a handler with bounded retries and configurable delay, reporting each attempt through a write callback so the run-log row reflects the current attempt.

nodes.name: safeWrite
nodes.summary: Wraps run-log row writes so a logging failure never masks (or crashes) the actual job handler — errors are logged, not thrown.

nodes.name: seedConfig
nodes.summary: Seeds dashboard configuration reference data when absent: road config (tolls/bonuses), the default 25→24 salary period, and monthly management fees for Jan–Jun 2026.

nodes.name: generateMonthTrips
nodes.summary: Generates a randomized month of trip seed rows by slicing the truck/driver assignment pool, distributing departure dates, and computing rounded VND amounts.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Inserts the generated months of trip rows (checking existing trip codes first) so KPI and chart queries have data across the dashboard's date range.

nodes.name: insertLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts one customer receivable ledger entry tied to a seeded trip and date, with deterministic doc numbering for the statement views.

nodes.name: seedReceivables
nodes.summary: Builds the receivables picture for the dashboard: AR ledger entries per customer derived from the seeded trips, including aging buckets.

nodes.name: seedExpenses
nodes.summary: Seeds per-trip expenses (fuel, tolls, ancillary fees) across the generated trips so expense-variance and P&L dashboards have realistic data.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Script entry point running the seeding stages in order — config, trips, receivables, expenses — with progress logging.

nodes.name: seed
nodes.summary: Main seeder: upserts the demo user accounts per role (hashing the shared Abc123 password, backfilling canonical contact identity on legacy rows), links drivers/suppliers by normalized name or phone, then calls every seed/* leaf module in dependency order and applies company-info defaults.

nodes.name: seedClerkScope
nodes.summary: Seeds the CUS clerk's customer scoping (user_customer_links) so the demo clerk account sees exactly the demo customer workspace.

nodes.name: resolveSeedReferenceIds
nodes.summary: Loads the post-seed ids of reference entities (routes, ports, customers, trucks) so the shipment seeder can link rows without hard-coded identifiers.

nodes.name: seedShipments
nodes.summary: Creates the demo shipment universe through the real service layer (createShipment, container upserts, document attach, status transitions) so seeded shipments exercise the same lifecycle code paths as production intake.

nodes.name: ports-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated port/terminal master data from the DATA PM workbook's THÔNG TIN CẢNG BÃI sheet: PortFromExcelSeed rows with name, address, e-port operation URL, and lifting fee.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated freight price matrix from the customer's report spreadsheets: PricingSeed rows per route/vehicle-size with share percentage, base price, and surcharge-inclusive price.

nodes.name: reference.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated reference master data: the port list with e-port web links, the route definitions (Hải Phòng–NEWEB/ASKEY/SUNRISE), and the container-type catalog used by reference seeding and pricing.

nodes.name: samples.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated sample-trip fixtures from the customer's real trip report: SampleTrip rows with customer/factory/route, bill and container numbers, weight, and full receivable/payable breakdowns for AR/demo flows.

nodes.name: vehicles.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated vehicle master data from the DATA PM workbook's LOẠI HÌNH XE sheet: VehicleSeed rows with truck/trailer plates, inspection and license deadlines, load limits, preferred route, and driver assignment.

nodes.name: seed-bulk-data.ts
nodes.summary: Synthetic volume seeder for local-dev QA: generates ~250 shipments, ~200 trips, ~30 customers, and ~60 expenses via plain DB inserts (deliberately bypassing the service stack for speed), with a BULK-marker idempotency probe and deterministic mulberry32 PRNG so reruns reproduce identically.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a seeded mulberry32 PRNG so the entire synthetic dataset is reproducible across reruns.

nodes.name: seed-customer-ar.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the customer AR chain through domain services: a DEBIT_NOTE draft→save (ISSUE via governance) for the first billing-eligible customer and a payment receipt with per-trip allocations — depending on the accepted e-PODs the trip seeder produced.

nodes.name: seed-customers.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customers and linked supplier records from the THÔNG TIN NCC sheet (Long Minh as both cargo owner and debit-note recipient), writes the Silver Sea company identity into app_settings, and installs the MẪU DEBIT LONG MINH column template used by debit-note exports.

nodes.name: seed-factories.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds factories/warehouses from the customer Excel data as operational sites linked to the LONG MINH customer, powering the 'Điểm lấy hàng' options in shipment intake forms.

nodes.name: seed-fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the fleet — trucks by plate, trailers, and drivers from the personnel sheet — matching each truck to its named driver through accent-insensitive name normalization and returning plate/driver lookup maps for later seed stages.

nodes.name: seed-forwarder-money.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds forwarder money flows through the domain services: advance requests in PENDING/APPROVED (with OPS_ADVANCE ledger)/REJECTED states plus forwarder-owned trip expenses, and one advance settlement linking the approved advances to their expenses.

nodes.name: seed-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny SQL-identity helpers shared by every seeder: normalizeSeedText (trim+lowercase) plus normalizedTextEquals/normalizedNullableTextEquals drizzle predicates that match columns case/whitespace-insensitively for idempotent resolve-or-insert logic.

nodes.name: seed-lift-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds container lift pricing per port × container type × direction (LIFT_UP/LIFT_DOWN) × load state with a computed base-price formula, effective 2026-08-01, resolving ids from the reference seed result.

nodes.name: makeRng
nodes.summary: Builds the deterministic mulberry32 PRNG from a numeric seed so the bulk dataset regenerates identically on every run.

nodes.name: resolveExistingCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Loads the ids of non-deleted customers so generated shipments can link to real customer rows.

nodes.name: genContainerNumber
nodes.summary: Generates a unique ISO-6346-shaped container number (4-letter owner code + U + 7 digits), retrying against the used set until unique.

nodes.name: seedBulkData
nodes.summary: Bulk-seed entry point: probes the BULK marker BL number and short-circuits if present, otherwise inserts customers, suppliers, drivers, shipments (status/date-weighted across 6 months), containers, trips with financial snapshots, and expenses in FK-safe order.

nodes.name: minimalPdf
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal valid PDF (header, one empty page, trailer) as a Buffer-backed upload object for seeding document attachments.

nodes.name: seedCustomerAr
nodes.summary: AR seed entry point: runs the debit-note issue then the payment receipt with per-trip allocations, in that order because debit-note candidates require accepted e-PODs.

nodes.name: seedDebitNote
nodes.summary: Generates and saves one DEBIT_NOTE draft for the first customer with billing-eligible (e-POD accepted) trips through the billing-document service.

nodes.name: seedPaymentReceipt
nodes.summary: Records one payment receipt with per-trip allocations against the seeded debit note through the payment-allocation service, producing the PAYMENT_RECEIVED ledger entries.

nodes.name: seedCustomers
nodes.summary: Resolve-or-inserts every customer from the extracted data as partner + customer + linked supplier rows (tax-code normalized for the unique index), returning the internalCode→customerId map later seed stages consume.

nodes.name: seedCompanySettings
nodes.summary: Writes the Silver Sea company identity (name, address, tax code, bank details, representative) into app_settings so exports carry the real issuer identity.

nodes.name: seedLongMinhDebitTemplate
nodes.summary: Installs the 20-column MẪU DEBIT LONG MINH template (variable bindings, header groups, widths, formats, totals) for the Long Minh customer's debit-note exports.

nodes.name: seedFactories
nodes.summary: Resolve-or-inserts each Excel factory as an operational site under the LONG MINH customer, matching by normalized name and preserving maps links and dock instructions.

nodes.name: normName
nodes.summary: Normalizes Vietnamese names for fuzzy matching: strips diacritics via NFD decomposition, maps đ→d, collapses whitespace, and lowercases.

nodes.name: seedFleet
nodes.summary: Seeds drivers (insert-or-skip by normalized name), trailers (unique plates), and trucks from the fleet sheet, linking each truck to its named driver via reassignTruckDriverInTx and returning plate/driver lookup maps.

nodes.name: seedForwarderMoney
nodes.summary: Entry point for forwarder money seeding: advances first, then the settlement that links approved advances with their expenses.

nodes.name: seedAdvances
nodes.summary: Creates four advance requests through the domain service with fixed Vietnamese reasons as idempotency keys, driving each to APPROVE (with ledger), REJECT, or leaving PENDING.

nodes.name: seedSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates one advance settlement linking the approved advance requests with their forwarder expenses through createAdvanceSettlement, keyed idempotently on the settlement note.

nodes.name: normalizeSeedText
nodes.summary: Trims and lowercases a nullable string to the canonical seed-matching form.

nodes.name: normalizedTextEquals
nodes.summary: Drizzle SQL predicate comparing lower(btrim(col)) to the normalized value — the idempotent match used by every resolve-or-insert seeder.

nodes.name: normalizedNullableTextEquals
nodes.summary: Nullable variant of the equality predicate that treats empty strings and NULL as equal via coalesce(nullif(...)).

nodes.name: seedLiftPricing
nodes.summary: Resolve-or-inserts lift_pricing rows for every port × container type × direction × load-state combination using the base+delta price formula, effective 2026-08-01.

nodes.name: seed-operational-sites.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customer-owned operational sites (factories + pickup warehouses) linked by stable tax code so the intake form's Nhà máy/Kho lấy hàng dropdowns are populated — closing the empty-dropdown customer bug.

nodes.name: seed-ports.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds ports/terminals from the Excel port sheet with stable terminal codes (HICT/HTIT/HHIT mapped by name, others derived by uppercase slug), matching live and soft-deleted rows for idempotency.

nodes.name: seed-pricing-tables.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the customer-provided freight price matrix as explicit pricing_tables rows (customer × route × size, effective 2026-07-30) for the LONG MINH customer, throwing when route or customer resolution fails.

nodes.name: seed-reference.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds reference data — ports, routes (from the MẪU BÁO GIÁ structure), and container types — inside one transaction serialized by an advisory lock, returning name/code→id maps consumed by the pricing and lift-pricing seeders.

nodes.name: seed-sample-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds per-route freight pricing for the demo sample customers (beyond LONG MINH, which the customer-audit seeder covers) so trip creation resolves non-zero TABLE revenue that the debit-note/AR chain derives from.

nodes.name: seed-trips.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds trips through the REAL dispatch chain (carrier allocation → handoff acceptance → dispatch-order issue → status transitions) so dispatch/ops screens show production-shaped data; establishes its own idempotent prerequisites (trailers per 60C truck, driver↔user links, an external carrier) and drives the full e-POD submission→acceptance chain on completed trips.

nodes.name: seed-vehicles-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds trucks and trailers from the Excel vehicle sheet with driver links via reassignTruckDriverInTx, updating existing rows matched by normalized plate and counting creates/updates/driver links.

nodes.name: seed-vendor-financials.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor-side financials through domain services with maker-checker separation (creator cannot approve): company expenses producing VENDOR ledger payables and fuel invoices with per-trip allocations approved for fuel-recon views.

nodes.name: wipe.ts
nodes.summary: Business-data wipe module: a grouped WIPE_TABLES list truncated in one TRUNCATE ... RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE statement, with a hard contract (test-enforced) that users, push subscriptions, agent tables, FAQ/knowledge chunks, and idempotency keys are never touched.

nodes.name: accounting-transport-register.service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the accounting transport register (sổ chuyến đi): a wide joined query over trips, customers, aliased carrier customers, containers, profitability snapshots, and carrier-payable ledger sums with a sort whitelist, canonical filter fingerprint for caching, and readiness ranking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses drizzle aliased subquery projections (jsonb_agg containers, grouped ledger sums) and a TIMEZONE-normalized completion business date at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'.

nodes.name: adjustment-governance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Central maker→checker→approver governance engine for financial changes to trips: request creators (AR adjustment, reopen, financial close, figure change, completed-trip cancellation) that validate period locks and close readiness, and the apply dispatcher that executes approved actions across trips, billing documents, price configs, debt offsets, advances, expenses, fuel invoices, credit overrides, and trip expenses.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately imports the governance CORE leaf rather than the transition hub to avoid a services-graph import cycle — the hub aggregates this service.

nodes.name: advance-request.service.ts
nodes.summary: Advance-request (tạm ứng) domain service: creation with requester-name snapshots, filtered/paginated listings with counts, and the maker/checker/approver governance ladder (request approval/rejection, approve, reject, apply) split out of advance.service.ts and re-exported through its facade.

nodes.name: seedOperationalSites
nodes.summary: Resolve-or-inserts each SiteSeed as an operational site keyed by the owning customer's tax code, keeping the seeder stable across different customer reseed paths.

nodes.name: portSeedCode
nodes.summary: Derives a port's stable seed code: known terminals map to their short code (HICT/HTIT/HHIT), everything else becomes an uppercased slug truncated to 20 chars.

nodes.name: seedPorts
nodes.summary: Resolve-or-inserts every Excel port, matching across live and soft-deleted rows (preferring live) and restoring soft-deleted matches rather than duplicating.

nodes.name: seedPricingTables
nodes.summary: Upserts the customer's freight price matrix rows (customer × route × size at the fixed effective date), counting persisted vs withheld entries and throwing when a route or the LONG MINH customer cannot be resolved.

nodes.name: seedReference
nodes.summary: Seeds ports, routes, and container types in one advisory-lock-serialized transaction, resolving soft-deleted matches and returning the name/code→id maps the pricing seeders consume.

nodes.name: seedSamplePricing
nodes.summary: Inserts per-route base pricing rows (keyed customer × route × container type × effective date) for every non-carrier demo customer so trips resolve non-zero TABLE revenue.

nodes.name: resolveSeedActors
nodes.summary: Resolves the demo actor users (cus, dieuvan, giamdoc, ketoan) by username and bridges users.id to AuthUser.userId, throwing with a clear message when the user seeder has not run.

nodes.name: ensureTrailers
nodes.summary: Guarantees one ACTIVE 40FT trailer per ACTIVE 60C truck (deriving RM- plates) plus the trucks.currentTrailerId link, because dispatch validation requires a trailer.

nodes.name: ensureDriverUserLinks
nodes.summary: Links every driver to an ACTIVE user account (dispatch validates the driver's user), creating accounts where missing.

nodes.name: ensureExternalCarrier
nodes.summary: Ensures one ACTIVE external-carrier customer with fleet vehicles so EXTERNAL dispatch assignments have a valid target.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Drives the real dispatch chain for READY_FOR_DISPATCH shipments — carrier allocation, handoff acceptance, dispatch-order issue, IN_TRANSIT/COMPLETED transitions — then adds expenses and runs the e-POD submission→CUS acceptance chain on completed trips, skipping shipments that already have live trips.

nodes.name: seedVehiclesFromExcel
nodes.summary: Upserts trucks and trailers from the vehicle sheet (matched by normalized plate), reassigns named drivers in transactions, and logs created/updated/driver-linked counts.

nodes.name: seedVendorFinancials
nodes.summary: Entry point running the two vendor-side stages — company expenses then fuel invoices — with distinct creator and approver ids to respect maker-checker.

nodes.name: seedCompanyExpenses
nodes.summary: Creates company expenses across suppliers, categories, and trucks through createExpense, keyed idempotently on expense notes so the payables panel has UNPAID/PAID rows.

nodes.name: seedFuelInvoices
nodes.summary: Creates fuel invoices with per-trip allocations and drives them to APPROVED (approver distinct from creator) so fuel-reconciliation views have data.

nodes.name: wipeTableList
nodes.summary: Flattens the grouped WIPE_TABLES record into the single ordered table-name array the truncate statement consumes.

nodes.name: planWipe
nodes.summary: Dry-run plan: returns the grouped wipe list plus the preserved tables without touching the database.

nodes.name: executeWipe
nodes.summary: Executes the wipe as one quoted TRUNCATE ... RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE over the flatten table list, returning the number of tables truncated; preserved tables are simply absent from the list.

nodes.name: canonicalFilter
nodes.summary: Normalizes a register query into its canonical form (null-coalesced filters plus a fixed tiebreak order) so identical filters hash identically for caching.

nodes.name: buildAccountingTransportFilterFingerprint
nodes.summary: SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical filter, used as a stable cache key for register responses.

nodes.name: conditionsFor
nodes.summary: Translates a register query into drizzle WHERE conditions: date window over the timezone-normalized completion date, customer/carrier ids, OWN/EXTERNAL ownership, readiness, and ilike search across trip code and container numbers.

nodes.name: listAccountingTransportRows
nodes.summary: Runs the full register query: joins trips with customers, the aliased carrier, aggregated containers, profitability snapshots, and carrier-payable sums; applies the whitelist-mapped sort with NULLs-last and pagination, returning rows plus totals for the sổ chuyến đi screen.

nodes.name: assertTripCanBeReopened
nodes.summary: Validates that a trip may enter a reopen governance action: no billing-document period locks, no payment allocations, and no other blocking financial state — throwing the matching ApiError otherwise.

nodes.name: requestTripArAdjustment
nodes.summary: Creates a maker governance action for an accounts-receivable adjustment on a trip (amount, signed-agreement reference, expected version), enforcing policy and period locks before inserting the pending action.

nodes.name: requestTripReopen
nodes.summary: Raises the exceptional-reopen governance request that keeps a COMPLETED trip locked until a distinct checker and approver complete the action.

nodes.name: assertNoPendingTripGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Guards against stacking: throws when an active governance action of the same kind (or against the same original version) already exists for the trip.

nodes.name: requestTripFinancialClose
nodes.summary: Raises the maker request to close a trip financially (IN_TRANSIT→COMPLETED path), first locking the trip-close aggregate and verifying close readiness (photos, expenses, e-POD scope).

nodes.name: requestTripFinancialChange
nodes.summary: Raises a governance action for figure edits on an already-completed trip (pre-departure/actuals changes after close), instead of allowing a direct write.

nodes.name: requestCompletedTripCancellation
nodes.summary: Raises the governed cancellation request for a completed trip — the only path to CANCELED after financial close — with period-lock and reversal checks.

nodes.name: approveGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Approver entry point: validates the checker/approver separation and version through the governance core, then applies the action inside a transaction.

nodes.name: applyGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Dispatches an approved governance action to the domain-specific apply function by action kind (billing, price config, debt offset, advances, expenses, fuel invoices, credit overrides, trip expenses, trips).

nodes.name: applyTripGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Executes approved trip-scoped actions end-to-end: reopen/cancel/close transitions through the status machine, figure updates, work-day sync/removal, financial postings and reversals, profitability snapshots, notifications, and GPS capture job enqueues.

nodes.name: listTripGovernanceActions
nodes.summary: Lists a trip's governance actions (most recent first) for the timeline the expense/adjustment panels render.

nodes.name: createAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Creates a PENDING advance request, snapshotting the requester's name up front so the approval trail survives later account removal, and returning the name-enriched row.

nodes.name: buildAdvanceRequestConditions
nodes.summary: Builds the drizzle WHERE conditions for advance listings: requester scope, status, escaped ilike search over reason/name, and exclusion of requests already tied to settlements.

nodes.name: advanceRequestOrderBy
nodes.summary: Maps the whitelist sort keys to drizzle order expressions with a stable tiebreaker for the advance listings.

nodes.name: listAdvanceRequests
nodes.summary: Lists advance requests with filters, name enrichment, and counts in one pass for the workspace panel.

nodes.name: listAdvanceRequestsPaginated
nodes.summary: Cursor/count pagination over the advance request list with clamped page/limit and total counts for the paginated table view.

nodes.name: getAdvanceRequestCounts
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-status counts (optionally scoped to one requester) for the advance workspace badges.

nodes.name: getAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Fetches a single advance request with name enrichment for the detail view.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceRequestApprovalGovernance
nodes.summary: Raises the maker governance action to approve a PENDING advance request, enforcing policy checks and optimistic version before creating the pending action.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceRequestRejectionGovernance
nodes.summary: Raises the maker governance action to reject an advance request with reason and evidence, mirroring the approval path.

nodes.name: approveAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Applies approval: transitions the request to APPROVED with optimistic version checks and writes the OPS_ADVANCE ledger entry through LedgerService.

nodes.name: rejectAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Applies rejection: transitions the request to REJECTED with optimistic version checks and records the rejecting actor.

nodes.name: applyAdvanceRequestGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Adapter the adjustment-governance dispatcher calls when an approved action targets an advance request: routes to approve or reject by the action's decision.

nodes.name: advance-settlement-reversal.service.ts
nodes.summary: Advance-settlement corrections: accountant expense adjustment with ledger deltas and snapshot history, governed reversal requests/applications (correcting a settled expense or reversing a whole settlement with ledger counter-entries), and rejection — split from advance.service.ts and re-exported through its facade.

nodes.name: advance-settlement.service.ts
nodes.summary: Advance settlement (phiếu hoàn ứng) lifecycle: creation that serializes claim checks before validation and snapshots linked expenses, enriched/paginated listings and detail reads, update with re-validation and approval propagation, then accounting check and approval with full ledger posting and notifications.

nodes.name: advance-shared.service.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-half advance helpers shared by the request and settlement leaves: optimistic-version guard, expense snapshots, settlement-code generation, name enrichment, page clamping, outstanding-balance queries, and the O2C auto-offset that nets approved expenses against outstanding advances when an expense is approved.

nodes.name: advance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Advances & settlements facade: named re-exports only (never export *) stitching together advance-shared, advance-request, advance-settlement, and advance-settlement-reversal so existing importers keep one unchanged import site identical to the pre-split surface.

nodes.name: conversations.ts
nodes.summary: Agent conversation read models for the REST surface: the sidebar's recent-conversation list (newest first) and full per-conversation message history with schema-validated responses — live chat transport itself is socket.io via agentSocket.

nodes.name: deterministic-report-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic report lane for the agent: serves the canonical profit / receivables / payables reports straight from pnl.service and aging.service with zero LLM calls, formatting results into insight_card widgets with per-metric provenance and a tool trace.

nodes.name: faq-fast-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Pre-LLM FAQ fast lane answering seeded domain questions from faq_entries via a 4-stage cascade: exact normalized match, rule-narrowed candidates, pgvector semantic match over HNSW with Redis-cached embeddings, and a score-floor+margin gate that abstains (fail-open to the LLM agent) on ambiguity or any error.
nodes.languageNotes: Thresholds (SCORE_FLOOR 0.40, MARGIN 0.12) are empirically tuned for text-embedding-3-small on short Vietnamese questions; the reference repo's 0.80+ values are model-specific and must not be copied.

nodes.name: financial-overview-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic company financial-health lane: three parallel service reads (P&L, receivables, payables) with zero LLM calls, building a director-facing overview card annotated with the as-of day so a partial month is never read as a full-month result.

nodes.name: intent-router.ts
nodes.summary: Lane 0 intent router between the FAQ lane and the orchestrator: deterministic Vietnamese/English rules classify each message into navigation (zero-LLM navigate directive via PAGE_CATALOG), summary, financial-overview, deterministic report, lookup, or full ReAct — fail-open to ReAct on low confidence, kill-switchable, and emitting an observability reason for every decision.

nodes.name: adjustSettlementExpense
nodes.summary: Accountant's expense adjustment on a settlement: locks the settlement row, validates version and trip state, patches the expense with before/after snapshots, and posts the buy/sell ledger deltas plus markup effects atomically.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceSettlementReversal
nodes.summary: Raises the governed reversal request for a settlement, enforcing policy (reason required, version expected) before creating the pending governance action.

nodes.name: applyApprovedSettlementCorrection
nodes.summary: Applies an approved settlement correction: re-patches the stored expense patch, reverses the original ledger entries, posts corrected ones, and updates settlement totals and payment-due dates inside the caller's transaction.

nodes.name: applyApprovedSettlementReversal
nodes.summary: Applies an approved full-settlement reversal: posts counter-entries that undo the settlement's ledger effect and reopens the linked advance requests/expenses for re-settlement.

nodes.name: applyAdvanceSettlementGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Adapter the adjustment-governance dispatcher calls for settlement actions: routes to the correction or reversal apply path by action kind.

nodes.name: rejectAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Rejects a settlement with optimistic-version checks, recording the rejecting actor and notifying the forwarder.

nodes.name: createAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates a settlement linking approved advance requests with forwarder trip expenses: serializes claim checks on an advisory lock, validates inputs and expense assignments, snapshots each expense, generates the settlement code, and computes totals.

nodes.name: buildAdvanceSettlementConditions
nodes.summary: Builds the drizzle WHERE conditions (forwarder scope, status, search, date window) for settlement listings.

nodes.name: listAdvanceSettlements
nodes.summary: Lists settlements with request enrichment and per-status counts for the workspace panel.

nodes.name: listAdvanceSettlementsPaginated
nodes.summary: Paginated settlement listing with clamped page/limit and totals for the table view.

nodes.name: getAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Loads one settlement with its linked advance requests, expense snapshots, and status history for the detail view.

nodes.name: assertSettlementBalanced
nodes.summary: Validates that a settlement's amounts balance (advances claimed vs expenses + refund) before check/approve transitions, throwing AdvanceError otherwise.

nodes.name: updateAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Updates a draft settlement's amounts/note/links with optimistic versioning, re-validating inputs and re-snapshotting expenses so a later approval approves exactly what was reviewed.

nodes.name: checkAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Accounting-check transition: verifies balance and version, moves the settlement into the checked state, and records the checker for maker-checker separation.

nodes.name: approveAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Final approval: re-asserts balance/version/checker separation, posts the settlement's ledger entries (expense recognition, advance clearance, refund), triggers approval propagation to linked expenses, resolves payment due dates, and notifies the forwarder.

nodes.name: assertExpectedVersion
nodes.summary: Optimistic-concurrency guard throwing a 409 AdvanceError (with the current version in the message) when actual ≠ expected.

nodes.name: expenseSnapshot
nodes.summary: Projects the financial fields of a trip expense into a plain snapshot record so settlements freeze exactly what was settled.

nodes.name: generateSettlementCode
nodes.summary: Generates the monthly-sequential settlement code (YY-MM-###) by locking and reading the max existing code for the month inside the transaction.

nodes.name: enrichWithNames
nodes.summary: Batch-resolves user display names for request/settlement rows, falling back to stored name snapshots when the account no longer resolves.

nodes.name: enrichSettlementWithRequests
nodes.summary: Attaches a settlement's linked advance requests (and their statuses/amounts) to the settlement payload for detail views.

nodes.name: clampPageLimit
nodes.summary: Clamps page/limit for advance listings with per-call-site defaults.

nodes.name: autoOffsetExpenseApproval
nodes.summary: O2C auto-offset: when a forwarder's expense is approved, automatically nets it against that forwarder's outstanding approved advances (advances first, then settlements), posting the offset ledger entries and updating settlement totals within the transaction.

nodes.name: getOutstandingAdvanceBalance
nodes.summary: Computes one forwarder's outstanding advance balance (approved advances minus settled amounts) for the workspace badge.

nodes.name: getOutstandingAdvanceBalances
nodes.summary: Batch variant returning every forwarder's outstanding advance balance in one query for list views.

nodes.name: listRecentConversations
nodes.summary: Returns the user's recent agent conversations (newest-updated first, capped) with empty message arrays for the sidebar list.

nodes.name: getConversationHistory
nodes.summary: Loads one owned conversation with its full message history, schema-validating each persisted assistant payload before returning.

nodes.name: runDeterministicReport
nodes.summary: Executes the requested canonical report (profit / receivables / payables for an optional month) via the P&L and aging services and shapes the result into an insight_card with provenance-tagged widgets and a tool trace.

nodes.name: tryExactMatch
nodes.summary: Stage 1 of the FAQ cascade: SQL-matches the normalized query against canonical questions and variants using diacritic-insensitive equality.

nodes.name: trySemanticMatch
nodes.summary: Stage 3: embeds the query (Redis-cached) and runs a pgvector cosine search with rule-narrowing terms, returning top candidates for the gate.

nodes.name: pickSemanticWinner
nodes.summary: Stage 4 gate: accepts the top candidate only when its similarity clears SCORE_FLOOR and leads the runner-up by MARGIN — otherwise abstains.

nodes.name: isExactMatch
nodes.summary: Predicate comparing the query against a question and its variant list after normalization.

nodes.name: tryFaqFastLane
nodes.summary: Entry point running the exact then semantic stages; returns null on no confident match or any error so the caller falls through to the LLM agent (fail-open).

nodes.name: buildFinancialOverviewResponse
nodes.summary: Pure card builder from the overview data: KPI widgets with correct financial signs, anomaly flags for overdue receivables/payables, and the as-of-day annotation — kept separate so wording and signs are unit-testable.

nodes.name: runFinancialOverview
nodes.summary: Runs the three parallel service reads (P&L, receivables summary, payables summary) for the current VN period and builds the overview response with timing and tool trace.

nodes.name: wordContains
nodes.summary: Word-boundary containment check (substring OR token-list membership) so Vietnamese intent keywords don't match inside unrelated words.

nodes.name: findPageMatch
nodes.summary: Scores the normalized query against PAGE_CATALOG titles and aliases to resolve a navigation target, sharing the exact matching rules of ui.search_pages so the router and the tool never drift.

nodes.name: extractPageQuery
nodes.summary: Strips leading navigation verbs and filler from the message to isolate the page-query remainder for matching.

nodes.name: routeIntent
nodes.summary: Main classifier: runs the deterministic rules in priority order (navigation, summary, financial overview, report, lookup) and returns a RouteDecision with lane, directive/query/report payload, and human-readable reason — defaulting to the full-ReAct lane on no confident match.

nodes.name: isSummaryIntent
nodes.summary: Detects daily-work summary phrasing ('tóm tắt việc hôm nay', 'cần làm gì') for the zero-LLM summary lane.

nodes.name: extractSimpleReportIntent
nodes.summary: Recognizes canonical report requests (profit/receivables/payables) with optional month/year expressions and returns the deterministic-report request payload.

nodes.name: extractLookupQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts the entity-search remainder from a lookup phrasing ('Số lốp 136.31' → '136.31') for the one-tool-call lookup lane.

nodes.name: knowledge-ingest.ts
nodes.summary: Doc-RAG ingest pipeline: reads CONTEXT.md and ADRs from disk, chunks markdown by heading (≤500 chars), embeds each chunk via the shared embeddings service, and upserts into knowledge_chunks keyed on (source_type, source_path, heading) so re-runs pick up edits without duplicates.

nodes.name: knowledge-retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: Doc-RAG retrieval over knowledge_chunks: embeds the query (Redis-cached, same pipeline as the FAQ lane), runs a pgvector cosine search with a docs-tuned similarity floor, and returns top-K chunks with citation metadata; fail-open to empty results on any error.

nodes.name: lookup-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Lookup lane (one tool call, zero LLM in v1): runs a single semanticSearch for entity-lookup queries and deterministically formats the results into a concise Vietnamese text answer with row details and navigation action chips, falling back to a clean not-found response.

nodes.name: orchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: The agent's ReAct loop: role-aware system prompt, iterated MiniMax tool-calls (role-checked execution, compacted results, streamed directives), a JSON-mode final answer with sanitize/validate/retry/degrade-to-text, resilient turn persistence, token attribution, and prose-path navigation synthesis — with sanitization/persistence/synthesis factored into sibling leaves that this file re-exports.
nodes.languageNotes: Written against the OpenAI-compatible MiniMax surface; tool selection and JSON adherence are guarded by deterministic fallbacks (salvage text, prose-path synthesis) rather than trusting the model.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Per-user chat rate limiter: Redis INCR+EXPIRE token bucket granting agentRateLimitPerMin messages per 60-second window, fail-open when Redis is absent or the limit is 0.

nodes.name: response-sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Structured-response sanitization for the orchestrator: think-block stripping and balanced-JSON extraction, jsonrepair healing, tolerance normalization (numeric coercion, table-widget shaping, directive sanitization) before Zod validation, trailing-prose preservation, internal-contract leak detection, tool arg/error formatting, and the protocol-safe tool-history trimmer.

nodes.name: routeMatcher.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a concrete SPA path back to { routeKey, params } using PAGE_CATALOG as the single source of truth — the deterministic safety net beneath the model's unreliable tool selection that converts prose paths into real navigate directives; numeric-param enforcement stays at the call site.

nodes.name: semantic-data.service.ts
nodes.summary: The data.* tool gateway's query engine: a declarative registry of 13 semantic entities (trips, tires, trucks, drivers, customers, expenses, ledger…) with per-field type defs, and builders for search/list/detail/aggregate/timeline queries — SQL built from whitelisted fields with soft-delete filters, clamped limits, and normalized rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Entities are declared as SQL field-definition maps rather than drizzle table objects, letting one generic engine serve search/list/detail/aggregate/timeline shapes.

nodes.name: stream-sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Streaming text-delta filter that strips model-internal markup (<think>, <tool_call>, <minimax:*>) before tokens reach the UI, buffering partial tags across chunk boundaries so a blocked tag split between deltas is still caught.

nodes.name: chunkMarkdown
nodes.summary: Splits a markdown document into semantic chunks by heading, further dividing chunks that exceed the 500-char budget, and tags each with its source type.

nodes.name: flushChunk
nodes.summary: Emits one accumulated heading+body chunk into the output list, trimming whitespace and splitting oversize bodies into continuation chunks.

nodes.name: ingestChunks
nodes.summary: Embeds the chunk batch and upserts into knowledge_chunks keyed on (source_type, source_path, heading), counting embedded/skipped rows and collecting per-chunk errors.

nodes.name: readContextMd
nodes.summary: Reads the repo's CONTEXT.md when present, returning null for a missing file.

nodes.name: readAdrs
nodes.summary: Lists the ADR directory and reads each markdown file, returning source paths paired with contents.

nodes.name: ingestAll
nodes.summary: Pipeline entry point: chunks CONTEXT.md plus all ADRs and ingests the combined chunk set.

nodes.name: chunkToCitation
nodes.summary: Converts a retrieved chunk into the citation shape (source id, heading, path excerpt) the agent response schema expects.

nodes.name: retrieveKnowledge
nodes.summary: Embeds the query (cached), runs the pgvector cosine search with the docs similarity floor, and returns top-K chunks — empty on any error (fail-open).

nodes.name: runLookup
nodes.summary: Runs the lookup lane: one semanticSearch call, deterministic Vietnamese formatting of results, and a not-found fallback answer.

nodes.name: formatLookupResponse
nodes.summary: Shapes search results into the text response: per-entity sections, row details, and a capped overall result list.

nodes.name: formatRowDetail
nodes.summary: Formats one entity row into a short label: value summary line for the lookup answer text.

nodes.name: buildLookupActions
nodes.summary: Derives navigation action chips from the lookup results so the user can jump straight to the found entity's page.

nodes.name: toolsToMiniMax
nodes.summary: Converts agent tool definitions into MiniMax function-tool descriptors via zodToJsonSchema.

nodes.name: directiveAckText
nodes.summary: Renders the honest Vietnamese acknowledgement text for a directive ('đã mở…' / 'không mở được…') keyed by ack outcome.

nodes.name: runAgent
nodes.summary: The full agent turn: tool selection per message, the bounded ReAct iteration loop (execute role-checked tool calls, compact results, stream directives), abort-signal handling, final JSON-mode answer with sanitize/validate/retry/degrade, turn persistence, and lane telemetry recording.

nodes.name: produceFinalAnswer
nodes.summary: Final-answer stage: JSON-mode call with truncation guard, one retry on invalid output, then degrade to a salvaged text response; preserves the richer detailed terminal text when a summary would lose information.

nodes.name: parseLatestAssistantResponse
nodes.summary: Extracts the text content of the last assistant message from the ReAct transcript.

nodes.name: checkRateLimit
nodes.summary: Atomically increments the user's per-minute Redis counter (setting the 60s expiry on first hit) and returns false once the configured limit is exceeded; fail-open when disabled or Redis is missing.

nodes.name: parseAgentResponseContent
nodes.summary: Parses raw model content into an AgentResponse: strips think blocks, extracts the first balanced JSON object, repairs near-valid JSON, sanitizes, and Zod-validates — preserving useful trailing Vietnamese prose as details for insight cards.

nodes.name: tryParseJson
nodes.summary: JSON.parse with a deterministic jsonrepair fallback; returns undefined when even repair cannot yield a value.

nodes.name: preserveDetailedTerminalText
nodes.summary: Keeps the model's detailed terminal text when the sanitized summary would be substantially less informative, so schema fallback doesn't erase a good answer.

nodes.name: salvageText
nodes.summary: Last-resort degradation: extract a clean text answer from unparseable model output (stripping markup and JSON fragments) so the user always gets something readable.

nodes.name: isInternalContractLeak
nodes.summary: Detects when trailing prose is leaking the internal response-contract wording (field lists, schema hints) rather than user-facing analysis, so it is dropped.

nodes.name: collectKnowledgeCitations
nodes.summary: Walks a sanitized response (widgets and text) gathering knowledge citations for provenance rendering.

nodes.name: safeParseArgs
nodes.summary: Parses raw tool-call arguments JSON defensively, returning null instead of throwing on malformed input.

nodes.name: formatToolError
nodes.summary: Formats a caught tool error into the string fed back to the model in the ReAct loop.

nodes.name: formatToolErrorLabel
nodes.summary: Prefixes a tool error with the tool name so the model can attribute the failure and choose a next step.

nodes.name: sanitizeAgentJson
nodes.summary: The big tolerance-normalization pass over a parsed agent payload: coerces numeric strings, normalizes widget shapes (kpi/bar/line/table/callout/anomaly), sanitizes directives and action chips, drops unknown keys, and rewrites the object toward what the Zod schema accepts before validation.

nodes.name: sanitizeDirective
nodes.summary: Validates and cleans a single directive object (kind-specific fields) before it can drive the UI.

nodes.name: coerceNumeric
nodes.summary: Coerces numeric-looking strings/numbers into safe finite numbers for widget values.

nodes.name: normalizeTableWidget
nodes.summary: Normalizes a table widget's columns/rows shape (array-vs-object tolerance, column label defaults) toward the schema.

nodes.name: extractFirstJsonObjectWithRemainder
nodes.summary: Extracts the first balanced JSON object from mixed prose+JSON content, returning both the object text and the trailing remainder.

nodes.name: trimToolHistory
nodes.summary: Protocol-safe tool-history trimmer: collapses older tool results in the ReAct transcript to summaries while preserving message-role structure, keeping iterations within the context budget without corrupting the OpenAI-compatible messages array.

nodes.name: matchRoute
nodes.summary: Matches a concrete SPA path against compiled PAGE_CATALOG routes (static and parametric), returning the routeKey plus decoded params.

nodes.name: sameRoute
nodes.summary: Compares two matched routes for equivalence (same routeKey and param values) so synthesized navigation can skip no-op jumps.

nodes.name: hasOnlyNumericParams
nodes.summary: Predicate ensuring a matched path's params are all numeric ids — the guardrail condition before converting prose paths into navigation.

nodes.name: listSemanticEntities
nodes.summary: Returns the metadata list for all registered semantic entities (what the agent can query).

nodes.name: getSemanticEntityMeta
nodes.summary: Fetches one entity's metadata (searchable/list/detail/filter fields, metrics) by name.

nodes.name: entityFieldNames
nodes.summary: Lists an entity's whitelisted field names for schema advertising to the model.

nodes.name: semanticSearch
nodes.summary: Cross-entity search: queries every entity in parallel (capped per entity) and merges ranked rows for the data.search tool and lookup lane.

nodes.name: semanticList
nodes.summary: Lists one entity's rows with whitelisted select fields, filters, and clamped limit.

nodes.name: semanticDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches one entity row's detail fields by id.

nodes.name: semanticAggregate
nodes.summary: Aggregation query over an entity (whitelisted metric + optional groupBy) with the same filter builder as list.

nodes.name: semanticTimeline
nodes.summary: Date-bucketed timeline query over an entity's date field for chart widgets.

nodes.name: buildSelect
nodes.summary: Builds the select clause from the entity's whitelisted field definitions for the requested field mode.

nodes.name: buildWhere
nodes.summary: Builds the WHERE clause: escaped ilike search over searchable fields, typed filters, date window, and the entity's soft-delete SQL.

nodes.name: normalizeRow
nodes.summary: Normalizes one raw query row (date/string coercions, null trimming) into the stable JSON shape the agent tools return.

nodes.name: createSafeTextDeltaFilter
nodes.summary: Creates the push/finish delta filter that withholds and strips model-internal tags (think, tool_call, minimax:*) before emitting safe text to the UI, buffering partial tag boundaries across chunks.

nodes.name: summary-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Role-aware daily-work summary lane with zero LLM calls: reuses the dashboard aggregation to build an insight_card with role-filtered decision items, KPI widgets (provenance-tagged via the metric registry), an anomaly list, and navigation action chips.

nodes.name: synthesis.ts
nodes.summary: A3 prose-with-path guardrail helpers: deterministically scan a prose answer for path-like tokens resolving to agent-navigable routes and convert them into real navigate directives / action chips — the safety net for when the model writes a destination instead of calling ui.navigate.

nodes.name: system-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: System-prompt builder — the agent's main context-engineering surface: assembles persona, role grant, time anchor, tool-usage policy, response-shape contract (kept verbatim, tuned against the schema), and the current-route hint; sections are exported separately for golden-parity unit tests.
nodes.languageNotes: The structured-response hint string is deliberately never paraphrased — its field list maps one-to-one onto AgentResponse in @tingting/shared, and the model was tuned against it.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OTel instrumentation helpers for the agent: withSpan/withRootSpan wrappers plus activeTraceId, with durations measured via performance.now so latency stays accurate even when the sampler discards the span (NonRecordingSpan).
nodes.languageNotes: Sampler-safe design: OTel samples at span creation, so a sampled-out span's onEnd never fires — performance.now() timing is unaffected.

nodes.name: text.ts
nodes.summary: The shared Vietnamese text normalizer for the agent layer: NFD-decompose, strip combining marks, fold đ/Đ to d, lowercase — one byte-identical implementation replacing three local copies so identical queries match identically across page-search, tour-search, and intent nets. Matching only; never for DB-bound or user-facing values.

nodes.name: token-attribution.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight token accounting: char-based estimates (~3.5 chars/token) split the prompt into system / tool-schema manifest / prior history / within-turn transcript so ballooning components are visible in logs — counts only, never prompt text (no PII or financial data logged).

nodes.name: tool-result-compact.ts
nodes.summary: Tool-result compaction for the ReAct loop: caps array rows, drops empty columns (annotating elisions), shrinks envelope payloads while keeping summary scalars, and — unlike a blind slice — cuts oversized JSON at a complete value/row boundary, re-closing any containers the cut left open so the model never sees corrupted JSON.
nodes.languageNotes: The boundary scanner tracks string escapes and bracket depth to find the last safe cut point, then synthetically closes open containers.

nodes.name: pathToRouteKey
nodes.summary: Maps a dashboard item's path to its agent route key so action chips can navigate to the relevant screen.

nodes.name: buildActionChips
nodes.summary: Deduplicates decision items into navigate action chips keyed by route.

nodes.name: buildKpiWidget
nodes.summary: Builds the role-aware KPI grid widget from dashboard stats, attaching metric-registry provenance to each value.

nodes.name: buildAnomalyWidget
nodes.summary: Shapes the attention-list anomalies into the anomaly_list widget for the summary card.

nodes.name: runSummary
nodes.summary: Runs the summary lane: fetches dashboard stats once, filters decision items by role, and assembles the insight_card response with KPI, anomaly, and action widgets.

nodes.name: synthesizeNavigateFromProse
nodes.summary: Scans a prose answer for path-like tokens, resolves each through the route matcher, and returns a navigate directive for the first route different from the user's current page (with default highlight when configured).

nodes.name: synthesizeTextActionsFromProse
nodes.summary: Wraps the navigate synthesis into the action-chip shape a text response carries.

nodes.name: buildSystemPromptSections
nodes.summary: Assembles the individual prompt sections (persona, time, tool policy, UI policy, route hint, structured-response contract) with tool-conditional instructions, exported for granular golden-parity tests.

nodes.name: buildSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Joins the sections into the exact prompt string sent to MiniMax — byte-identical to the pre-refactor inline version.

nodes.name: withSpan
nodes.summary: Wraps an async fn in an active OTel span with independent performance.now duration; records exceptions and status on rejection and re-throws the original error.

nodes.name: withRootSpan
nodes.summary: Root-span variant for a whole agent turn, returning the traceId so logs and the persisted turn correlate.

nodes.name: activeTraceId
nodes.summary: Returns the current active span's trace id (undefined outside a span) for log correlation.

nodes.name: normalizeText
nodes.summary: Folds Vietnamese text to a diacritic-insensitive lowercase form (NFD, strip marks, đ→d) for matching only — never DB-bound or user-facing values.

nodes.name: estimateTokensByComponent
nodes.summary: Splits the char-based token estimate across system prompt, tool-schema manifest, prior history, and within-turn transcript so per-component growth is visible in logs.

nodes.name: formatAttribution
nodes.summary: Formats the attribution breakdown into a compact log line.

nodes.name: compactToolResult
nodes.summary: Compacts a tool result to the char budget: shape arrays (cap rows, drop empties), shrink envelope payloads row-by-row, and otherwise cut at the last complete value boundary.

nodes.name: dropEmpties

layers.description: Agent working contract (AGENTS.md) and development-context entrypoint (CONTEXT.md) governing how work happens in this repo.

tour.title: Entry point: from bootstrap to container
tour.description: Start where the process starts. backend/src/index.ts wires the whole app in a fixed order — telemetry first, then Casbin, DB, audit and notification services, route mounts, the agent socket, the scheduler, and graceful shutdown — so every later subsystem is reachable from this file. The Dockerfile shows the same entry point shipping to production as `node dist/index.js`, and config/index.ts is the zod-validated environment contract everything reads.

tour.title: The HTTP route layer: family sub-routers
tour.description: Every API surface is an Express router family (trips, shipments, financial, forwarder) split into leaf modules, where each index.ts registers audit events for its write paths and mounts leaves so static segments beat /:id patterns. The crud-factory generates standard list/create/read/update/delete endpoints with pagination, optimistic locking, and idempotent writes — learn it once and most config routes read like configuration.

tour.title: Auth & RBAC: JWT meets Casbin
tour.description: Two gates guard every request: auth.ts verifies the JWT against a Redis blacklist and enforces customer-scope equality, then the Casbin middleware maps HTTP methods to read/write/delete actions against the policy matrix. The enforcer is a boot-time singleton over model.conf and policy.csv — role permissions (ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT, DISPATCHER, OPS, CUS, DRIVER, CUSTOMER) live in the CSV, and edits require a restart.

tour.title: The @tingting/shared package: contracts and money math
tour.description: Backend and frontend never define their own contracts: shared/src re-exports ~700 symbols — zod schemas, ~160 domain types, and the API path constants both sides mount against — from one barrel. The calculations folder holds the financial authorities: round2dp/roundInt for VND precision, tripTotals for fuel/road/toll math, and tripDriverSalary for per-trip wage computation. Changing any of these ripples into both packages, which is why they carry the broadest QA gates.

tour.title: Data schema: Drizzle over Postgres
tour.description: db/index.ts builds the postgres.js client and the Drizzle instance every service consumes; the schema barrel re-exports 11 split modules so drizzle-kit sees one unchanged surface. Skim core (users, audit, notifications, idempotency keys), then the domain modules — shipments and trips hold the operational tables, financial is the largest with ledger, billing documents, salary periods, advances, and governance actions. Repo invariant: Drizzle only, no raw SQL in application behavior.

tour.title: Domain core I: the shipment lifecycle (CUS lane)
tour.description: A shipment is born in the CUS clerk flow: intake asserts readiness and assigns the carrier, the cus-shipment-workspace family serves the clerk's read/write surface, lifecycle performs governed completion/cancellation/soft-delete, and the accounting-lock family hands custody to accounting where documents become immutable. This chain is the product's P0 surface — chứng từ (documents) — and most governance rules exist to protect it.

tour.title: Domain core II: trips — read/command split and the status machine
tour.description: Trips are the biggest service family, organized as read leaves (trip-queries: filtered lists, dashboard, fully-shaped detail) and a command layer (trip-command) that wraps every mutation with idempotency, report-cache invalidation, and notifications. The status machine is the heart: transitionTripStatus enforces role checks, posts the ledger at completion, and cascades pair-lifecycle effects — trace any trip bug from here.

tour.title: Domain core III: dispatch planning and fleet assignment
tour.description: Dispatch connects shipments to trips: the planning family (barrel over queries, commands, and detail-plan) reads candidate lots, the commands service issues or re-issues dispatch orders (phát lệnh) and asserts resource availability, and dispatch-handoff runs the UNSEEN→SEEN→ACCEPTED/REJECTED handoff with version snapshots for conflict detection. truck-driver-assignment is the single authority enforcing the one-truck-one-driver rule.

tour.title: Domain core IV: billing, payments, treasury, and payroll
tour.description: Money flows through four authorities: billing-document (draft/invariant/posting pipeline for customer billing), payment-allocation (receipts allocated across trip receivables inside ledger transactions under maker-checker governance), financial-posting (trip completion and correction postings), and treasury (kho-quỹ cash/bank positions and cutover). salary-period-close closes the loop on the payroll side with payslips and exclusions.

tour.title: The correctness backbone: governance, audit, transactions, idempotency
tour.description: This codebase's signature pattern: sensitive mutations go through maker-checker governance (governance-policy declares who may make/check/approve each action kind; governance-action-core row-locks and applies effects inside the approval window), while audit.service persists sanitized audit context in-transaction for every material write. Beneath it, tx.ts joins or opens transactions and idempotency replays stored responses for retried requests — together they make the money paths safe to retry and audit.

tour.title: Async platform: scheduler, GPS, push, and cache
tour.description: The scheduler registry defines cron jobs with FNV-1a-derived advisory-lock keys so multiple pods race one Postgres lock and only one wins; the runner executes reminder, durable-effect, and GPS-capture jobs. gps.service polls the Bach Khoa GPS provider through a pull-through Redis cache into the live-fleet view, trip-gps-capture-job queues per-trip track capture at governance approval, and push.service delivers web-push with dead-endpoint cleanup. redis.ts and report-cache.ts provide the single-flight cache and the single registry for reports:* invalidation keys.

tour.title: The AI assistant: agent socket, intent router, and LLM lanes
tour.description: The newest lane: agentSocket streams AG-UI protocol events over a JWT-authenticated socket.io /agent namespace, and the intent router classifies each message into zero-LLM lanes (navigation via PAGE_CATALOG, FAQ, deterministic reports) or the full ReAct orchestrator with role-checked tools from tool.registry. provider-registry resolves the active LLM provider (MiniMax or OpenRouter) from admin settings — a self-contained subsystem you can explore last since it touches the domain only through tools and the semantic data gateway.
